permission_denials.command:
cd ~/source/personal/vloop; gofmt -l tools; go vet ./tools/... && go test ./tools/... 2>&1|tail -5
c=$(mktemp -d); git clone -q . $c/self; cd $c/self; git checkout -q main 2>&1; git -C . status -sb | …
c=$(mktemp -d) && git clone -q ~/source/personal/vloop "$c/self" && git -C "$c/self" checkout -q main && echo "$c" && git -C "$c/self" tag | tail -3 && git -C "$c/self" status -sb | head -2
mkdir -p .vloop/tmp/rd && git clone -q . .vloop/tmp/rd/self && git -C .vloop/tmp/rd/self checkout -q main && git -C .vloop/tmp/rd/self status -sb | head -2
